title: Schematify holds screens and flows as design nodes without pixel-level visual design
context: Journeyman held visual mockups and interactions as user-facing design. The alternative would be to store full visual design artifacts.
decision: Schematify stores screen names, purposes, states, acceptance conditions, and links to external Claude Design projects. Pixel-level visual design remains in Claude Design; Schematify references it but does not hold it.
consequences: Cleaner separation of concerns and lighter data model; visual design stays in its native tool; but requires users to reference external design artifacts; agents cannot drive pixel-level changes from Schematify.
